newsitem.title: FRANCE: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde - July 17.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde - July 17.

text.p: These are leading stories in afternoon daily Le Monde.

-- State to keep "determining" stake in defence electronics firm Thomson-CSF but willing to reduce it to allow the group to forge alliances. A new privatisation process, the third for the group, set for this year.
-- Arms manufacturer Giat Industries to be recapitalised, Finance Minister Dominique Strauss-Kahn told National Assembly defence committee yesterday.
-- Gemplus French microchip card manufacturer to become IBM 's privileged supplier worldwide.
-- Prime Minister Lionel Jospin has asked the mediator assessing Eramet New Caledonia nickel mining to report by September 15.
